topic: Requesting raw demographic data from Tractor
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on obtaining detailed demographic information, specifically in a 'raw format,' from a third party referred to as 'Трактор' (Tractor). [me] inquired about the ease of communication with this source and the possibility of receiving raw demographic data. [p1] stated that they had limited recent contact with the source and mentioned that the relevant contacts were on vacation until the 6th, making a quick response uncertain. Regarding two similar files previously received, [p1] confirmed that the source provided them. Ultimately, both participants decided not to initiate further communication with the source at this time.
decisions: Will not contact the data source (Трактор) regarding raw demographic data.
